orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Bred for war on the red plains. Orcs shrug off stuns and hit like falling rocks.

racial.name: Blood Fury
racial.desc: +15% attack power for 15 sec. 2 min cooldown.

troll.name: Troll
troll.description: Lanky, cunning and quick to heal. The Duskmane trolls fight with a grin full of tusks.

racial.name: Berserking
racial.desc: +20% attack speed for 12 sec. 2 min cooldown.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Dead, risen, and deeply unimpressed by it. What still holds together is held by spite.

racial.name: Will of the Forsaken
racial.desc: Removes stun, root, slow and fear effects. 2 min cooldown.

human.name: Human
human.description: Stubborn survivors of the old kingdoms. Humans learn quickly and rally faster than most.

racial.name: Second Wind
racial.desc: Restore 20% health over 10 sec. 3 min cooldown.

wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
wood_elf.description: Children of the deep pines. Wood elves move like wind through branches — and are gone as fast.

racial.name: Quickening
racial.desc: +30% movement speed for 8 sec. 2 min cooldown.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Carved from the Graystone hills, beard-first. Dwarves endure what would flatten lesser folk.

racial.name: Stoneform
racial.desc: Removes bleed and poison effects and increases armor by 30% for 8 sec. 2 min cooldown.
